prompts.front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one orthographic character reference image for Hunyuan3D multiview mesh reconstruction, FRONT view.
Input image: style and design reference only, showing low-poly medieval peasants. Create ONE original adult male peasant in that same deliberately simple, faceted game-asset style. Do not reproduce the lineup, background, text or branding.
Character: lean average-height middle-aged man, bald crown with short dark brown hair on sides and back, short angular dark brown beard, simple face with small eyes and neutral expression. Muted mustard ochre tunic reaching upper thighs, small V-slit neckline, elbow-length sleeves with simple rolled cuffs, narrow dark brown leather belt with a plain small buckle, a small simple brown belt pouch at the character's RIGHT hip (viewer LEFT in this front view). Muted brown straight trousers and simple dark brown ankle shoes. No other accessories.
Style: truly low-poly flat-shaded 3D geometry, broad planar facets, very sparse details, simple solid color materials, like the supplied reference. No fabric weave, realistic skin, painted highlights, decorative seams, photorealism, high-poly sculpt detail or outlines.
Camera and pose: exact straight-on FRONT orthographic elevation, camera level and without perspective distortion, head facing directly forward. Symmetric relaxed A-pose: both straight arms extend 25 degrees away from the torso in the body's frontal plane, hands relaxed with simplified grouped fingers and a distinct thumb; legs straight, feet shoulder width apart, toes forward. Identical anatomy and pose will be used for side and back images afterward.
Framing: one full-body figure centered on a SQUARE canvas, crown at 10 percent from top and soles at 90 percent; entire body including hands and shoes visible with generous clear margins. True transparent background with alpha, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no ground plane or cast shadow. Soft neutral ambient illumination so broad facets read gently; no directional dramatic light.
Constraints: ONLY one front view; no labels, text, watermark, borders, grid or collage. Prioritize clean silhouette and simple reproducible forms suitable for a matching 3D turnaround.
prompts.left:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a SINGLE orthographic view for a Hunyuan3D multiview character reference set.
The supplied image is the exact character and pose to preserve. Generate another camera angle of THIS SAME low-poly 3D peasant as if rotating a camera around one unchanged mesh. Preserve identical head size, body proportions, balding dark-brown hair, short angular beard, ochre mustard upper-thigh tunic, elbow-length rolled sleeves, dark narrow belt, small brown pouch on anatomical RIGHT hip, muted brown trousers, cuffed brown ankle shoes, faceted topology style and flat material palette. Do not redesign, embellish, or change costume.
POSE INVARIANT: keep the front reference's symmetric A-pose fixed in 3D: arms straight down and outward about 25 degrees from vertical within the body's frontal plane; relaxed hands at upper-thigh height; legs straight and feet shoulder-width apart. Rotate CAMERA ONLY.
Keep simple broad planar low-poly geometry, no realistic textures or skin, no fine detailing. Neutral soft ambient illumination with gently visible facets. True transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no ground or cast shadow.
Framing: same square canvas and full-body scale as the supplied image, same crown and sole heights, same belt and tunic hem heights, entire figure with clear margins. No labels, text, logos, borders, collage or additional views.
Requested camera angle: EXACT 90-degree SIDE PROFILE. Nose and toes point toward the LEFT edge of the image, matching Hunyuan's left.png convention. Show only one eye and one ear in true profile, no three-quarter face. The camera sees the character's anatomical RIGHT side, including the belt pouch. In this side projection the arms overlap in depth and the near hand hangs alongside the upper thigh; do NOT swing an arm forward to display it. The feet likewise overlap naturally in profile. Body is upright, facing image-left.
